name: Bark to Bones
description: Use Alchemy to Transmute a tree into a stack of bones for all your grisly needs.

name: Decorated Adventurer
description: Unlocks the Armour Mannequin and Cape Rack, allowing you to display all of your Armour Sets and Capes with pride!

name: Superheat
description: Cast on fire-based stations to empower them and boost their processing speed for a while.

name: Superheat Upgrade
description: Speed Boost now lasts even longer.

name: Storage Ledger
description: Unlocks the Storage Ledger building piece.

name: Magical Mending
description: Throw your items down and repair them instantly through the power of Nature Magic.

name: Magical Mending Upgrade
description: Restores even more durability to your tools!

name: Artisan Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Artisan Skillcape.

name: Overdrive
description: Cast on mechanical-based processing stations to empower them and boost their processing speed for a while.

name: Overdrive Upgrade
description: Speed Boost now lasts even longer.

name: Adaptability
description: Evading or blocking no longer interrupts your combos when using a melee weapon!

name: Enchant Weapon: Air
description: Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Air! Increases your Melee Weapon's Attack Speed.

name: Enchant Weapon: Fire
description: Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Fire! Apply Burning to Enemies with Critical Hits!

name: Enchant Weapon: Water
description: Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Water! Strike enemies with Water damage and occasionally create healing orbs to restore your health.

name: Attack Potion
description: Unlock the recipe for the Attack Potion at the Brewing Cauldron.

name: Weapon Expertise
description: Unlocks additional attacks for all Melee Weapons.

name: Melee Weapon Special Actions
description: Unlocks unique Special Actions for Melee weapons!

name: Parry
description: Parry attacks by blocking at the last moment to stagger your Enemies and deal increased damage!

name: Attack Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Attack Skillcape.

name: Sprint Attacks
description: Unlocks the ability to perform a Unique Sprint Attack action after sprinting for a short distance.

name: Tempest Shield
description: Conjure a Shield of Air Magic that prevents all damage while blocking for a limited time, triggering a powerful burst when the spell ends. Attack levels increase duration.

name: Tempest Shield Upgrade
description: Your shield now lasts longer.

name: Training Dummy
description: Unlocks the ability to build a Training Dummy to test your melee weapons on.

name: Weapon Rack
description: Unlocks the ability to build a Weapon Rack to display your weapons.

name: Whetstone
description: Allows crafting of whetstones at the Crafting Table, which can be used to sharpen melee weapons for increased damage!

name: Desert Dweller
description: Unlock the extended Kharidian building kit.

name: Bastion
description: Unlocks additional stone building pieces.

name: Baroque Stone
description: Unlocks additional stone building pieces.

name: Creature Comforts
description: Unlocks an assortment of furniture and decorations.

name: Eye Of Oculus
description: Become the mystical Eye of Oculus and build Structures easier and with a whole new perspective!

name: Fine Details
description: Unlocks small building pieces.

name: Middle Ground
description: Unlocks medium-sized building pieces.

name: Mighty Oak
description: Unlocks the next tier of building pieces.

name: Country Side
description: Unlocks Thatch Roofs

name: Eye of Occulus Upgrade
description: Now magnetizes materials into your inventory.

name: Personal Chest
description: Access your Personal Storage chest from anywhere.

name: Sacred Geometry
description: Unlocks triangular building pieces.

name: Construction Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Construction Skillcape.

name: Construction Material Weight Reduction
description: Reduces the weight of Construction Materials.

name: Summon Shelter
description: Construct a temporary Shelter through the power of Astral Magic. It even has a Bed!

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 1
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 1 Ingredients

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 2
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 2 Ingredients

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 3
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 3 Ingredients

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 4
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 4 Ingredients

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 5
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 5 Ingredients

name: Culinary Confidence: Power Level 6
description: Reduces the chance to Burn Power Level 6 Ingredients

name: Bones to Peaches
description: Transmute unwanted bones on the ground into fresh Peaches for your consumption. Inhumane? Yes... but delicious!

name: Adept Culinaromancer
description: Unlocks a collection of Perk granting recipes at the Stone Range and Range.

name: Amateur Culinaromancer
description: Unlocks a collection of Perk granting recipes at the Stone Range and Range.

name: Fancy Cookware
description: Unlocks decoration piece Pan Rack in the building menu.

name: Grill Master
description: Unlocks the Grill

name: Internal Alchemy
description: Refreshes any active Food and Drink buffs with a spectacular display of culinary appreciation.

name: Cooking Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Cooking Skillcape.

name: Teamonger
description: Unlocks a collection of Perk granting recipes at the Stone Range and Range.

name: Yes, Chef!
description: Unlocks recipe for Chef's Hat, craftable at the Crafting Station.

name: Compost Bin + Bucket
description: Unlocks the Compost Bin and Compost Bucket recipes. These allow for creating and using Normal Compost to boost the yield and disease resistance of your plants.

name: Uproot
description: Channeling the power of the earth, summon a spectral surge that gently coaxes ripe plants from the soil. Within a small radius, all fully grown crops and wild plants are instantly harvested and drawn towards you.

name: Harvester
description: With greater mastery over the land, the caster’s reach extends even further. Harvester expands Uproot’s range to a wider radius.

name: Humidify
description: Conjure Water magic to create a rain cloud that travels forward, instantly watering any Farming Plot that it passes over with Clean Water.

name: Cleansing Rain
description: Upgrades the Humidify Spell, causing the conjured rain cloud to cure any diseased plants it passes over alongside watering them.

name: Large Water Barrel
description: Unlocks the Large Water Barrel, which stores even more Clean or Dirty Water collected from Watering Cans for later use.

name: Mucksplosion
description: Not for the squeamish gardener! This spell harnesses Earth magic to summon a bubbling compost volcano, showering your beloved plots with rich, nourishing fertilizer.

name: Plant Cure
description: Unlocks the ability to create Plant Cures at the Cooking Range! Use Plant Cures to heal your plants from disease.

name: Rain Catcher
description: Collects and filters rain water into usable Clean Water over time.

name: Scarecrow
description: Unlocks the Scarecrow, a perfect companion for your crops!

name: Iron Secateurs
description: A pair of gardening Secateurs that boost your harvesting yield while equipped.

name: Farming Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Farming Skillcape.

name: Speedy Farmer
description: You've become more adept at watering and composting your plants. You can now do so with less penalty to your movement speed!

name: Super Compost Bin
description: Unlocks the Super Compost Bin which produces Super Compost, for an even better yield boost and disease resistance of your plants.

name: Tree Farming
description: You are skilled enough at farming to now grow Trees! Trees can be planted directly into the ground and seeds can be found while chopping down trees and from birds nests.

name: Water Barrel
description: Unlocks the Water Barrel, which stores Clean or Dirty Water collected from Watering Cans for later use.

name: Well
description: Unlocks the ability to build a Well! A Well provides a limited amount of Clean Water per day. Wells refill in the morning.

name: Air Magic
description: Summon the unrelenting force of Air! Equip Air runes to unleash the power of wind against an enemy, dealing high single target damage and knocking your enemies down!

name: Confuse
description: Twist the minds of lesser enemies, making them unable to distinguish between friends and foes for a limited time.

name: Enfeeble
description: Weakens the attacks of the targeted opponent.

name: Arcane Expertise
description: Unlocks an additional powerful magical attack at the end of staff magic combos.

name: Fire Magic
description: Wield the destructive force of fire. Equip Fire runes to deal medium damage to enemies in a large area and build up burning on them to reduce them to ash.

name: Greater Confuse
description: The Confuse spell now works on a wider variety of creatures.

name: Magic Potion
description: Unlock the recipe for the Magic Potion at the Brewing Cauldron.

name: Magic Focus
description: Allows crafting of magic focus at the Crafting Table, which can be used to imbue magic staves to increase their damage!

name: Afterimage
description: Distract your enemies by leaving behind an illusionary image for a short time when you use your first Surge Charge.

name: Runic Refund
description: Your greater understanding of magic gives you a 30% chance to preserve runes when attacking with magic.

name: Magic Special Actions
description: Unlocks unique Special Actions when casting spells with a Staff!

name: Magic Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Magic Skillcape.

name: Surge
description: Channel arcane power into your dodges, travelling further and evading longer as a result.

name: Vengeance
description: Is being vindictive a virtue? I think so! A spell that reflects your enemies' damage right back at them.

name: Water Magic
description: Conjure the supportive power of Water! Equip Water runes to Damage and Slow your enemies while also healing yourself and your allies. Kills with Water magic have a chance to spawn Water orbs.

name: Mine Crumbled Walls
description: Allows you to knock down crumbled walls with a pickaxe, granting access to hidden or blocked areas.

name: Summon Stone Spirits
description: Call on the Stone Spirits to guide you to the nearest rocks you can mine!

name: Divine Rock
description: Drop 5 ore on the ground and turn it into a personal mining vein!

name: Accelerated Veins
description: Chance for the Divine Rock to drop little surprises in the form of Gems!

name: Gem Prospector
description: Mining ore now sometimes produces precious gemstones.

name: Ingot Weight Reduction
description: Reduces the weight of ingots by 50%

name: Ore & Stone Storage
description: Unlocks Ore and Stone Storage, a high-capacity storage for ores and stones.

name: Not-So-Heavy Metal
description: The weight of metal ores is reduced by 25%

name: Rocksplosion
description: Conjure a powerful blast to break apart stone boulders and ore.

name: Ultimate Burst
description: Increased Rocksplosion's AOE for the most powerful burst!

name: Mining Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Mining Skillcape.

name: Lift With Your Hips
description: The weight of stone, clay, and sand raw material is reduced by 25%

name: Archery Target
description: Build an Archery Target to practice your Ranged accuracy against. Shoot the Bullseye for a surprise!

name: Enchanted Crossbow Bolts
description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

name: Lucky Bolts
description: Increases the chance for enchanted crossbow bolts to trigger their magical effects.

name: Fire Starter
description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

name: Hunter's Sense
description: Crouch for a short time to activate your Hunter Senses, allowing you to sense nearby Creatures and Enemies.

name: Make 'em Bleed
description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

name: Quick Action
description: Perform Quick Attacks.

name: Ranged Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Ranged Skillcape.

name: Snare
description: Conjure Earth Magic at your feet and lay a trap for your Enemies! Those caught inside this trap become rooted in place for a short time.

name: Spectral Arrows
description: Enchant your equipped bow with Astral Magic, causing arrows to penetrate through multiple targets.

name: Toxic Behaviour
description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Poison, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Poison or to craft Poisonous Arrows.

name: Trick Shot
description: After firing a fully drawn arrow, release follow up shots at the right time for increased damage!

name: Crossbow Trick Shot
description: Trick Shot now applies to Crossbow Weapons. Fire at the right time to instantly finish reloading and ready your next shot!

name: Venomous Trapper
description: The Snare trap now triggers a cloud of poison when it is activated, causing enemies stuck inside it to become poisoned over time.

name: Air Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting air runes.

name: Astral Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting astral runes.

name: Earth Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting earth runes.

name: Fire Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting fire runes.

name: Law Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting law runes.

name: Nature Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting nature runes.

name: Water Efficiency
description: Get a better yield when auto-crafting water runes.

name: Air Rune
description: Unlocks recipe for Air Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Astral Rune
description: Unlocks recipe for Astral Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Summon Elemental Spirits
description: Call on the Wisps to guide you to nearby Anima Vents you can siphon!

name: Greater Elemental Spirits
description: The Summon Elemental Spirits perk now also indicates which Anima Vents are Concentrated.

name: Earth Runes
description: Unlocks recipe for Earth Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Fire Runes
description: Unlocks recipe for Fire Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Fire Spirit
description: Conjure forth a fire spirit to light your way.

name: Law Runes
description: Unlocks recipe for Law Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Nature Runes
description: Unlocks recipe for Nature Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Pure Essence
description: Unlocks a chance of the Pure Essence Stone eruption while siphoning. It's hard to catch... But the reward is a burst of Catalytic runes...

name: Essential Strength
description: The weight of rune essence is reduced by 50%

name: Runecrafting Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Runecrafting Skillcape.

name: Water Runes
description: Unlocks recipe for Water Runes, craftable at the Rune Altar.

name: Home Teleport
description: Teleport safely back to your bed and enjoy a peaceful, undisturbed night's sleep.

name: Better infusion duration
description: Reduces the infusion phase duration of runecrafting.

name: Lesser infusion duration
description: Reduces the infusion phase duration of runecrafting.

name: Greater infusion duration
description: Reduces the infusion phase duration of runecrafting.

name: Runes To Rune Essence
description: Too many runes of the wrong type and no essence around? Throw your runes on the ground, and this spell will draw out their magic, leaving you with 40% of the rune essence.

name: Runes To Rune Essence Upgrade
description: As your mastery grows, so does your yield. You can now extract 60% of the rune essence.

name: Windstep
description: Summons the power of Air Magic to Jump higher and Descend slower.

name: Greater Anima Siphoning
description: Each Anima Vent siphon consumes 1 rune essence to produce 15 runes.

name: Lesser Anima Siphoning
description: Each Anima Vent siphon consumes 1 rune essence to produce 12 runes.

name: Axtral Projection
description: Conjures an Astral Axe and launches it forward, instantly chopping down trees in its path.

name: Axtral Projection Upgrade
description: Now it conjures three spectral axes, carving through even more trees along their path.

name: Bird Nests
description: It is now possible to find bird nests while felling trees. Bird nests contain useful items.

name: Chop Thorny Vines
description: Allows you to cut down thorny vines with a hatchet, granting access to hidden or blocked areas.

name: Lumber Backpack
description: Stylish? Yes! But not only that... A highly functional backpack that improves your luck with rare wood resource drops. It also lightens the weight of carried wood, and gives a gentle boost to woodcutting progression.

name: Lumber Storage
description: Unlocks Lumber Storage, a high-capacity storage for logs and planks.

name: Overhead Chop
description: You can now perform an overhead chop, which deals greater damage against fallen logs, but very little damage against trees.

name: Trunk Totem
description: Transmute scattered tree trunks into a single totem. Follow up with "Splinter" for more efficient lumberjackery.

name: Woodcutting Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Woodcutting Skillcape.

name: Splinter
description: A powerful spell that chops fallen trees into wood logs.

name: Wood Weight Reduction
description: Reduces the weight of wood by 50%

name: Hitting Hard
description: Woodcutting Critical Hit Chance

name: Rapid Growth
description: Advances plant growth by one stage. Cannot be reapplied until the plant grows further.

name: Overgrowth Aura
description: Increases range of Rapid Growth spell.

name: Air Dash
description: While airborne dash forwards covering a short distance quickly.

name: Backpacker
description: Increases your max carry weight.

name: Breakfall
description: You now roll when falling a great distance. Increases the distance before fall damage is taken and reduces fall damage.

name: Brynmoor Courses
description: Unlocks Brynmoor Courses.

name: Dowdun Reach Courses
description: Dowdun Reach Courses

name: Fellhollow Courses
description: Unlocks Fellhollow Courses.

name: Ghornfell Courses
description: Unlocks Ghornfell Courses.

name: Umbral Sands Courses
description: Unlocks Umbral Sands Courses.

name: Double Jump
description: Allows the use of a second jump while airborne.

name: Explorer
description: Increases your max carry weight.

name: Greater Breakfall
description: Further reduces fall damage

name: Hopper
description: Reduces stamina cost for jumping

name: Common Burrower
description:
Allows the use of the Brynmoor & Ghornfell Burrow networks.

Burrows let you travel through the underground tunnel network of the Kebbits. These burrows cover great distances and can go between regions.

name: Dark Burrower
description: Allows the use of the Dowdun Reach Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.

name: Desert Burrower
description: Allows the use of the Umbral Sands Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.

name: Razor-backed Burrower
description: Further reduces the chance of taking damage and the amount received when traveling through the Kebbit Burrow network.

name: Wild Burrower
description: Allows the use of the Fellhollow Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.

name: Nomad
description: Increases the amount of passive experience gained from exploration.

name: Agility Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Agility Skillcape.

name: Phase Dash
description: Allows the use of a second dash whilst airborne.

name: Recall
description: Places a temporary beacon at your current location, allowing you to return to it within a limited time.

name: Reactive Recall
description: Recall now automatically triggers upon receiving fatal fall damage, protecting the caster.

name: Windstomp
description: Stagger nearby enemies when landing from Windstep.

name: Stamina Potion
description: Unlocks the recipe to craft Stamina Potions that prevent stamina drain from all actions.

name: Trailblazer
description: Increases the amount of passive experience gained from exploration.

name: Fishing Skillcape
description: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Fishing Skillcape.
